name: tailgate
description: Review what your AI coding agent just changed, while it keeps working.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Tailgate runs git and the Claude Code CLI against the open folder, so it only works in trusted workspaces.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Tailgate needs a git repository on disk.

enumDescriptions: The Claude Code CLI, using your Claude sign-in.
GitHub Copilot, using the Copilot Chat extension and your Copilot sign-in.
tailgate.provider.description: Which service writes the reviews. Your code is sent to the one you choose. Cannot be set per workspace.

tailgate.copilotModel.description: Copilot model family to use, for example gpt-4o. Leave empty to use the first model Copilot offers.

tailgate.claudePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI used to write reviews. Cannot be set per workspace.

tailgate.model.description: Model alias or full model name passed to the Claude CLI. Cannot be set per workspace.

tailgate.autoReview.description: Write a review automatically once the files have stopped changing. Each review uses your Claude usage. Cannot be set per workspace.

tailgate.autoReviewDelaySeconds.description: How long the files must stay unchanged before an automatic review starts.

tailgate.liveReview.description: Review each changed file by itself as soon as it stops changing, while the Tailgate panel is open. Each file review uses your Claude usage. Cannot be set per workspace.

tailgate.liveReviewDelaySeconds.description: How long a file must stay unchanged before its live review starts.

tailgate.exclude.description: Extra glob patterns for files whose contents must never be sent for review, for example "**/config/private/**". Lock files, generated files and common secret files are always left out.

tailgate.maxDiffChars.description: Largest diff, in characters, sent for review. Files that do not fit are left out and listed as skipped.

tailgate.timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for a review before giving up.
